336:248.en: 「Hand it over. I'll set real stats-」

336:387.en: 「Trust me, picture it. You'll deck him.」

336:497.en: 「Obviously! I came to bring you back!」

336:881.en: 「Fine! Way better than a bad captain!」

336:1568.en: 「Come on! Show me what you've got!」

336:2210.en: 「I won't let that opening slip by!」

336:2437.en: 「You're relying on $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

336:2542.en: 「You want to crush me that badly?!」

336:2575.en: 「That AS...! What the hell is it?!」

336:2678.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」

336:2890.en: 「I can't grasp it, but I can end it!」

336:3151.en: 「Drop their leader, and we can win!」

336:3321.en: 「I'm sick of looking at that face!」

336:3377.en: 「Today's the last I'll see of you!」

336:3696.en: 「We won't sit back and be destroyed!」
alternatives: We won't stand by and be destroyed!

336:3960.en: 「We can do this as we are now!」

336:3991.en: 「Fine. I'll push us to the limit!」

336:4358.en: 「Sorry, but I have no sympathy in me!」

336:4393.en: 「I'm on trash duty, $$相良宗介$$!\nI'll clean up the universe's trash!」

336:4448.en: 「I won't let the likes of you\nmess with $$千鳥$$'s and my future!」

336:4503.en: 「Al, I'm using the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

336:4544.en: 「The image is set... I can do this!」

336:4604.en: 「Al, activate the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

336:4689.en: 「Diverting $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ to attack!」

336:4724.en: 「Can I do it...? No, I have to!」

alternatives: If they hit us, we hit back!

336:5936.en: 「I'll fulfill the role I was given!」

336:5990.en: 「We'll take them down one by one!」
alternatives: We'll pick them off one by one!

336:6270.en: 「We can pay them back double later.」

336:6544.en: 「I don't have time to play with you!」

336:6606.en: 「You have no combat sense at all!」

336:6668.en: 「A waste of time! Stay out of this!」

336:6736.en: 「Though it gave me a cold sweat...!」

336:6794.en: 「A joke attack won't take me down!」

336:6829.en: 「That AS is all looks, no bite!」

336:6858.en: 「I can't lose to you, of all people!」

336:6899.en: 「$$ラムダ・ドライバ$$,\nand that's all?!」

336:6948.en: 「$$ラムダ・ドライバ$$...\nstill not mastered!」

336:7372.en: 「I grant your courage in facing me.」

336:7512.en: 「That stung a little, but I'm fine.」

336:8022.en: 「More of $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$'s power...!」

336:8059.en: 「To counter it,\nwe must use that too!」

336:8147.en: 「I look like a total amateur fool!」

336:8211.en: 「If I can move, I can still fight...!」

336:8246.en: 「I must at least regain my footing!」

336:8283.en: 「End it next time, or I'm dead...!」

336:8363.en: 「Fine. I'll fight you to the end!」

336:8434.en: 「I would have already, if I could...!」

336:8521.en: 「No...! The unit is over its limit!」

336:8618.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!」
alternatives: Is this as far as we go...?

336:8658.en: 「$$カシム$$, $$カシム$$... Don't get chummy!」

336:8811.en: 「TDD-1 is a sub, so terrain is hard...」

336:9014.en: 「A break? Good timing. Get some rest.」

336:10059.en: 「For a next shot,\nlet's get fired up.」

336:10257.en: 「$$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ has activated.」

336:10404.en: 「An easy win, as they say, Sergeant.」

336:10874.en: 「Rest needs calm nerves. Try a joke.」

336:11583.en: 「I have no underwater aiming\ncorrection data, though.」

336:11717.en: 「A one-off unit is unfit as a weapon.」

336:11882.en: 「$$ストライカー#pilot$$,\nyou are what's called a damn fool.」

336:11987.en: 「After combat, I'd like to debate\nGod's existence at length.」

336:12052.en: 「Let's teach them they're\nno match for us.」

336:12101.en: 「A self-styled Supreme God losing to\na human and AI. Thrilling, Sergeant.」

336:12234.en: 「I'll call that well done, this time.」

336:12294.en: 「After a direct hit from that,\nit stands no chance.」

336:12419.en: 「Then I'll leave the timing to you.」

336:12675.en: 「Impossible, reckless, outrageous...\nTypical of your tactics, Sergeant.」

336:12761.en: 「If my thinking has neared yours,\nSergeant, it's complicated.」

336:12909.en: 「Yes, so that is how it is.」

336:12965.en: 「No damage to the unit detected,\nmain capacitor voltage stable too.」

336:13035.en: 「I did not expect to dodge\nin this manner.」

336:13138.en: 「How do you like the new unit?」

336:13171.en: 「$$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ operating normally.」

336:13235.en: 「Is this what they call a joke?」

336:13550.en: 「At this rate, the unit falls apart.」

336:13670.en: 「It has been a long time, Sergeant.」

336:13697.en: 「Affirmative. But I'm ARX-8 $$レーバテイン$$.」

336:13754.en: 「Sergeant $$相良$$. Request permission for your return to war.」

336:13805.en: 「Before I try it, I want to ask.」

336:13909.en: 「Time for the great joke I promised, Sergeant.」

336:14047.en: 「Sergeant, that's a pun, not a joke...」

336:14114.en: 「After all that time? Disgraceful. Worthless pig.」

336:14189.en: 「Ha ha, THAT is a joke, Sergeant.」

336:14286.en: 「$$ウルズ$$ 7, I look forward to your work.」

336:14380.en: 「When we meet again, let's kiss for sure.」

336:14559.en: 「Hey, shouting through a loudspeaker at midnight?! I'll resume, okay?!」

336:15195.en: 「I'll turn that unit into\na pile of pathetic scrap...!」

336:15250.en: 「If you don't want to die,\ntry begging pitifully...!」

336:15305.en: 「Now, let's begin simple coercion\nand the volleys that follow...!」

336:15358.en: 「I came here to give you\na thoroughly hard time...!」

336:15510.en: 「A pro delivers results\nwith the equipment given...!」

336:15610.en: 「I'll do it for $$ナミ$$'s sake too...!」

336:15668.en: 「I came to save her! Don't interfere!」

336:15762.en: 「$$千鳥かなめ$$! Can you hear me?!」

336:15801.en: 「$$アマルガム$$! I'll repay every debt!」

336:15840.en: 「I'll stop your scheme at all costs!」

336:15941.en: 「I have a place to return to now...!」

336:16017.en: 「I won't let our future be ruined...!」

336:16269.en: 「Do you think we can do it?」

336:16348.en: 「Looks like we have to do it...!」

336:16419.en: 「Go ahead and give them a handicap.」

336:16446.en: 「No choice but to do it. Focus.」

336:16754.en: 「Unknown or not, it can be beaten!」

336:16830.en: 「Burn up as a red shooting star!」

336:16974.en: 「I will stop you without fail,\n$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$!」

336:17033.en: 「If you insist on\ndenying the world as it is!」

336:17082.en: 「Even if we can join hands, not now!」

336:17189.en: 「Lose to a lawless mob\nwith no discipline...?!」

336:17454.en: 「I said I'm sick of your faces!」

336:17532.en: 「As the trash collector, I can't\nleave you lying around!」

336:17659.en: 「I'm fairly used to dealing\nwith big ones!」

336:17795.en: 「I must stop you with all I've got!」

336:17922.en: 「I'll smear your so-called ideals\nwith germ-ridden crap!」

336:18110.en: 「Whoever gets in the way of love,\nI'll kick them for the horse!」

336:18165.en: 「You're nothing but a Pilot Support\nEnlightenment System!」

336:18218.en: 「Next to you, my partner\nis still several notches better!」

336:18271.en: 「Learn a thing or two from $$チェインバー#pilot$$!」

336:18314.en: 「No coward here will just\nsit quietly and be destroyed!」

336:18373.en: 「If you want to destroy humanity,\nbeat me first!」

336:18484.en: 「Just land a hit first!\nThen we talk!」

336:18694.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$...!\nYou'll regret laying hands on Earth!」

336:18759.en: 「No need to hold back on invaders!」

336:18788.en: 「Whatever power you use,\nskill decides in the end!」

336:18837.en: 「Show me the power of your $$スフィア$$!」

336:18901.en: 「I don't intend to take that poison!」

336:18934.en: 「I won't lose to a gloomy,\nsullen jerk!」

336:18987.en: 「A Supreme Commander on the field?\nYou must be very sure of yourself!」

336:19069.en: 「With the Emperor dragged out,\nall that's left is to strike!」

336:19120.en: 「$$次元将$$ with $$スフィア$$...!\nDon't let your guard down!」

336:19210.en: 「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$!\nI'll deliver your last rites!」

336:19267.en: 「Run off with your tail between legs\nand whine to your god!」

336:19322.en: 「An emissary of God strolling out?\nThat's not very awe-inspiring!」

336:19383.en: 「Idiot! Did you think I'd gratefully\nreceive your divine oracle?!」

336:19450.en: 「They claim to be emissaries of God.」

336:19524.en: 「I'll play with you!\nUntil you cry and beg forgiveness!」

336:19581.en: 「Pay for betrayal with your own body!」

336:19659.en: 「From now on, you'll be wiped out\nby the inferior Earthling race!」

336:19712.en: 「Hurry up, tuck your tail and\ngo call your $$御使い$$s!」

336:19767.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nYou're history's worst hypocrite!」

336:19820.en: 「I'm keeping $$千鳥$$ waiting.\nGet out of my way, now!」

336:19943.en: 「Don't say I don't get a turn!」

336:19980.en: 「This is what you get for dawdling!」

336:20054.en: 「Don't think you can shake me off!」

336:20159.en: 「I'll take the rest of the feast!」

336:20300.en: 「Losing our president is a Volunteer Club loss!」

336:20343.en: 「$$レド$$! Pull $$チェインバー#robot$$ back!」

336:20612.en: 「What do you mean, unable to attack?!」

336:20647.en: 「All I can do is stand and watch...」

336:20705.en: 「A fitting attack for trash like you.」

336:20734.en: 「Small fry can only do so much!」

336:20777.en: 「Go home and let Mommy comfort you!」

336:20818.en: 「I won't let it be\nwrecked any further!」

336:20867.en: 「This is no damn frog!\nIt's $$アル$$ II!」

336:20918.en: 「Rusty, but it can do this much!」

336:20974.en: 「Save data 120 sec before and after\nto File Z-1.」

336:21103.en: 「Master Mode 6.\nStay alert with the anti-$$ＥＣＳ$$ sensor.」

336:21154.en: 「Not bad. Even with a junk AI.」

336:21376.en: 「No problem if I avoid direct hits!」

336:21505.en: 「As expected of one of the greatest\nArm Slaves ever built.」

336:21604.en: 「If so, all it gets is a sneer.」

336:21635.en: 「Don't say that. Fight them all out.」

336:21670.en: 「Men, soldiers, and weapons alike,\nlooks don't decide their worth.」

336:21719.en: 「Getting one over on me\nis quite something...!」

336:21768.en: 「Guh...!\nDid I overtrust the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$?!」

336:21817.en: 「Damn it!\nFalling for a feint is pathetic!」

336:21950.en: 「As long as the system's alive,\nthere's a way!」

336:22209.en: 「Whatever the situation,\nI'll do all I can!」

336:22344.en: 「Hydraulics losing power?\nAt a time like this...!」

336:22434.en: 「I can't die before I get her back!」

336:22471.en: 「I promised to bring her back!\nNot here...!」

336:22664.en: 「One more time is all I need!」

336:23081.en: 「Still got a smart mouth, even now.」

336:23215.en: 「This range...! I have to use this!」

336:23511.en: 「You handle aiming and firing of\nthe Zeros and GEC!」

336:23562.en: 「Spare no ammo. Volley on my signal!」

336:23900.en: 「You know I play rough.\nHow long have you been my partner?」

336:23967.en: 「Diverting $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ to attack!」

336:24187.en: 「$$千鳥かなめ$$, hear me?! I'm here to bring you back!」

336:24244.en: 「Honestly, $$千鳥かなめ$$, I'm disappointed. I thought you were greater.」

336:24333.en: 「Never thought you'd be a weak woman who quits after one game over-」

336:24424.en: 「Next is the player. 'Persuasion' by threat to play 36 hours-」

336:24503.en: 「Taking a break from the game too, Captain?」

336:24544.en: 「C-C-Captain?! I'll get the medic now, so hang on!」

336:24654.en: 「Paused... Good timing. Take a long break.」

336:24705.en: 「Fine. I promised, so I'll see it through!」

336:24815.en: 「Quiet! Shut up and end the game!」

336:24902.en: 「You're an AI! Don't laugh it off!」

336:24966.en: 「...The junk Master Sergeant agrees. See you.」

336:25099.en: 「It's fine. I'll catch you for sure.」

336:25229.en: 「With you here, I need no weapons.」
